prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1404; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presents following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the vehicle was changing lanes. Presenting complaints consisted of neck pain, stiffness, and limited cervical range of motion, with associated muscle guarding noted on examination. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported force of impact and with the pattern of symptoms described. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm a cervical strain. No prior injury to the cervical region is known from the patient's history or available records. Conservative management was provided over fifteen visits, including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction. Care followed a typical course, with pain intensity and range of motion improving steadily, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as the patient progressed. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate billing identified. At discharge the patient reported near-resolution of symptoms and was advised to continue a home exercise program and return if symptoms recur.
